import base64,hashlib,json,os,stat,sys
ROOT='/home/qian/hepta-runtime-validation-cost-20261106-d2'
LIMIT=1024*1024
def need(ok,msg):
 if not ok: raise RuntimeError(msg)
raw=sys.stdin.buffer.read(LIMIT+1)
need(len(raw)<=LIMIT and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==sys.argv[1],'copy packet identity')
doc=json.loads(raw)
need(doc['schema']=='hepta-original-holder-byte-copy/v1','packet schema')
need(doc['original_job_id']=='1a1b13e79b5-fc05-7739','original holder identity')
top={'c1-holder-native-01.json','c1-holder-native-read-01-000.json','c1-holder-start-01.json','c1-holder-report-01.json'}
payload={}
for row in doc['files']:
 name=row['path']
 parts=name.split('/')
 need((len(parts)==1 and name in top) or (len(parts)==2 and parts[0]=='c1-holder-originals-01' and parts[1] not in {'','.','..'}),'copy destination')
 need(name not in payload and all('\\' not in x and '\x00' not in x for x in parts),'duplicate/unsafe destination')
 data=base64.b64decode(row['data_base64'],validate=True)
 need(len(data)==row['bytes'] and len(data)<=65536 and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],'original bytes differ')
 payload[name]=data
need(top<=payload.keys(),'native originals incomplete')
report=json.loads(payload['c1-holder-report-01.json'])
expected={'c1-holder-originals-01/'+p['file'] for p in report['log_files']}
need(set(payload)==top|expected and len(payload)==25,'exact original log inventory')
for p in report['log_files']:
 data=payload['c1-holder-originals-01/'+p['file']]
 need(len(data)==p['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==p['sha256'],'holder report log binding')
flags=os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC
rootfd=os.open(ROOT,flags)
try:
 st=os.fstat(rootfd)
 need(st.st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o700,'root owner/mode')
 for name in top|{'c1-holder-originals-01'}:
  try: os.stat(name,dir_fd=rootfd,follow_symlinks=False)
  except FileNotFoundError: continue
  raise RuntimeError('create-only destination already exists: '+name)
 os.mkdir('c1-holder-originals-01',0o700,dir_fd=rootfd)
 logfd=os.open('c1-holder-originals-01',flags,dir_fd=rootfd)
 try:
  for name,data in sorted(payload.items()):
   parts=name.split('/'); parent=rootfd if len(parts)==1 else logfd; leaf=parts[-1]
   fd=os.open(leaf,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,0o600,dir_fd=parent)
   with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:
    stream.write(data);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
   rd=os.open(leaf,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK|os.O_CLOEXEC,dir_fd=parent)
   with os.fdopen(rd,'rb') as stream:
    observed=stream.read(len(data)+1);st=os.fstat(stream.fileno())
   need(observed==data and stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink==1 and st.st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o600,'copy readback differs')
  os.fsync(logfd);os.fsync(rootfd)
 finally: os.close(logfd)
finally: os.close(rootfd)
print(json.dumps({'copied_original_files':len(payload),'payload_bytes':sum(map(len,payload.values())),'packet_sha256':sys.argv[1],'original_holder_job_id':doc['original_job_id'],'runtime_or_workload_executed':False},sort_keys=True))
